summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend regression testing for OMNIA audit P0/P1/P2 fixes (C1, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, H3, H4, H9, H10, H12, H13, H14, H15, M1, M3/M4/M6, M10). Created new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_audit_p0_p1_final.py with 25 tests — ALL PASSING (100%). Frontend Playwright validated: open-redirect sanitization, super_admin sidebar (all items visible), billing page (4 Stripe tiers rendered w/ MODALITÀ TEST badge), reset-password page data-testids, /fr/login → /it/login redirect, LanguageSwitcher navigate (no reload), publishing page links (no /edit).
critical_code_review_comments: C1 whitelist properly guards super_admin/group_admin/branch_admin — verified via 3 POST /register variants.
C7 SSRF guard covers metadata (169.254.169.254), loopback (127.0.0.1, localhost), private RFC1918 (10.0.0.1) — all return 400 url_not_allowed.

H3 moderation queue: super_admin=200, agent=403 (correctly restricted). Note: I could NOT independently verify group_admin=403 without seeding a group_admin user; if desired, main agent can add a seed step.

H10 upload-tmp works end-to-end: super_admin POST → {id,url:/api/media/...} → GET /api/media/{path} returns image/jpeg binary. Auth guard blocks non-agency users (agent w/o agency_id gets 403 as expected).
H14 refresh: active user returns 200, no-cookie returns 401. C6 requires seeding a second group_admin to fully assert 403 agency_not_owned; current test only asserts super_admin path is not 500.
H15 billing status without cookie → 401 confirmed.
H9 HAL knowledge ask returns sources (JSON-serialized TF-IDF working, no pickle).
M3/M4/M6 regex-safe search: 5 regex-special queries (`a(b`, `a[b`, `a\b`, `a*b`, `a?b`) all return 200 (no 500).
M10 frontend redirect /fr/login → /it/login verified via Playwright.
M1 LanguageSwitcher uses router navigate — URL changes to /en without hard reload.
